stem: The graph of the quadratic function \(y = f(x)\) in the \(xy\)-plane has \(x\)-intercepts \((-4, 0)\) and \((10, 0)\). The maximum value of \(f(x)\) is 49. What is the value of \(f(0)\)?
solution: Write \(f(x) = a(x + 4)(x - 10)\). The vertex is midway between the intercepts, at \(x = 3\).
verify:
x, a = symbols('x a')
f = a*(x + 4)*(x - 10)
av = solve(Eq(f.subs(x, 3), 49), a)[0]
assert av == -1 and solve(diff(f, x), x) == [3]
assert f.subs({a: av, x: 0}) == 40
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == 40
